archival_format_basis.warc_basis: Library of Congress describes WARC as a web-archive format for combining harvested web resources with related metadata.
archival_format_basis.wacz_basis: WACZ packages WARC data and metadata in a ZIP-style container for distribution/replay; it complements rather than replaces WARC.

nonclaim: The manifest lists targets and preferred capture methods only. It does not capture payloads or admit claims.
